title: GlossMark graph record
description: One line of .glossmark/graph.jsonl. The first line is a context header; then one node record per graph node, sorted by (node type, id); then one edge record per triple, sorted. Mirrors graph.Header, graph.Node, graph.Edge and graph.Prov in internal/graph/graph.go and marker.Anchor in internal/marker/anchor.go (exact JSON tags; omitempty fields are absent when zero).

iri.description: A node identifier: an absolute IRI (https://onto.acme.dev/zoo/Horse), an artifact URN (urn:gloss:artifact:<path>[#<symbol>]), an actor URN (urn:gloss:actor:<kind>:<name>), or a placeholder URN (urn:gloss:new:<curie>, urn:gloss:glob:<pattern>, urn:gloss:unresolved:<text>).

fingerprint.description: sha256: followed by a hex prefix of the digest of the normalized signature (symbol/block/line anchors) or of the whole file (file anchors).

generator.description: Tool and version that wrote the file, for example "gloss 0.1.0".

prefixes.description: CURIE prefix → IRI base table used to abbreviate ids.

@context.description: Relative path of the JSON-LD context document (./context.jsonld).

format.description: Record format version; readers refuse a newer one.

node.description: One graph node (graph.Node). Which attributes appear depends on the node type: concept nodes carry tier, kind, published-as, internal, deprecated, replaced-by, value and imported; boundary nodes carry kind (= level), owner and dir, and deprecated, replaced-by and retire-by when retiring; artifact nodes carry path, anchor and boundary; namespace nodes carry tier, version and owner; actor nodes carry kind (human, agent, ...).

curie.description: CURIE alias of id when a prefix matches (impl:Horse, acme:horse-factory-svc, impl: for a namespace, human:claude for an actor).

ns.description: Prefix of the namespace the node belongs to.

tier.description: Ontology tier of a concept or namespace node.

kind.description: Concept kind (entity, process, capability, event, measure, constraint, resource, system-type); boundary level (domain, system, container, component); declaration kind of an artifact (file, function, class, resource, table, sql, heading, ...); actor kind (human, agent).

kind-from.description: Concept: CURIE of the nearest is-a ancestor its kind was inherited from; absent when the kind is declared.

published-as.description: Concept: CURIE of the core concept this implementation concept surfaces as.

deprecated.description: Concept or boundary: being retired; see replaced-by.

replaced-by.description: Concept or boundary: the CURIE that supersedes it.

retire-by.description: Boundary: the date (YYYY-MM-DD) a deprecated boundary is due to be retired.

value.description: Concept: the documented attribute value from the ontology (any JSON value).

imported.description: Concept: true when the concept comes from an imported namespace.

owner.description: Namespace or boundary: owning team or actor.

criticality.description: Concept, boundary or artifact: effective governance level (docs/GOVERNANCE.md).

criticality-floor.description: Boundary: its level is a floor for the artifacts beneath it.

value-from.description: path:line of the code a published value is bound to.

live-value.description: The bound code line, as it reads in this tree.

value-fp.description: Fingerprint of the bound line (sha256: prefix).

criticality-from.description: Where the level comes from: "declared", or the CURIE of the node it was inherited from.

boundary.description: Artifact: IRI of the boundary that contains it, from the nearest manifest.

dir.description: Boundary: directory of its manifest, slash-separated, relative to the repo root ("" for the root, hence usually absent).

file.description: Source file of the declaration, for diagnostics.

anchor.description: Where a marker binds in a file (marker.Anchor): a line range, an optional symbol, and a content fingerprint.

symbol.description: Declaration name, for example breed_stallion, Mare.foal, resource.aws_sqs_queue.capture, table.foals, Deployment/web.

kind.description: Declaration kind: function, method, class, interface, type, variable, resource, block, key, item, sql, alter, gherkin, heading, document, definition, instruction, proto, unresolved-symbol, json-pointer (a sidecar range; symbol holds the pointer), ...

start.description: First line of the anchored region (1-based).

end.description: Last line of the anchored region (inclusive).

p.description: Predicate: a relation name from the vocabulary (builtin or declared in an ontology file).

o.description: Object node id (may be a placeholder URN for unresolved, new or glob targets).

source.description: Where the edge came from: declared (ontology files and manifests), inline (@gloss markers), derived (rollup rules) or inferred (inferrers such as test paths).

path.description: Repo-relative file the edge was read or derived from.

line.description: Line of the marker or declaration (1-based).

proposed.description: True for a proposed (?-suffixed or unaccepted) link.

conf.description: Confidence of a proposed link, in [0,1].

actor.description: Who placed the marker, as kind:name.

sugar.description: True when the edge comes from a shorthand marker form expanded by the parser.

rule.description: Rollup rule or inferrer that produced a derived or inferred edge (for example realization-lift).

via.description: CURIEs (or artifact ids) the derivation passed through.

raw.description: The original target text as written (.Local, impl:NEW:X, pa:*).

alias.description: The relation as written when the marker used an alias stored as its canonical relation (tests, stored as verifies).
